## 2fc4ca4ea6c4

**Finding: reproduced override-contract defect.** The generator source SHA-256 is `15901d0d35ab6b59a7ef06a8846862e4d44c4cc8f3e36b90d0acc937e617d84b`, matching the immutable audit assignment.

The source advertises `grid_h=3..12` and `grid_w=7..16`, but at seed `42`, sample index `0`, `grid_h=3` raises `ValueError: draw_int('grid_h'): override 3 outside [5, 8]` and `grid_w=7` raises the analogous `[9, 13]` error. The declared controls `palette_kind=warm`, `palette_size=1`, `n_distinct_colors=1`, and `texture=cool` all produce a grid byte-for-byte identical to the unoverridden draw. An undeclared `unknown_axis=1` is also silently accepted and produces that same grid.

Checks performed: actual canonical Racket matched all **3/3** published pairs; 32 default draws in each of easy, medium, and hard were validator-clean and unique (**96/96** total); the exact override cases above were replayed. This is an interface/distribution defect, not evidence that the canonical rule is wrong. I made no changes to this audit target. Full source-bound evidence, default input, actual Racket output, declared axes, and exceptions are in `checks/audit-2fc4ca4ea6c4.json`.

## 2fc4ca4ea6c4

**Reproduced shortcut: regular generation never teaches the length-1 identity
case.** The audited generator hash is
`15901d0d35ab6b59a7ef06a8846862e4d44c4cc8f3e36b90d0acc937e617d84b`;
the executed canonical rule hash is `bc623d507a59`.

A production probe sampled 900 regular examples (seed 20261004; 300 per band),
found 4,000 same-color horizontal runs, and found **0 length-1 runs**
(`checks/audit/2fc4ca4ea6c4/production_probe.json`). Thus the rival “collapse
only length-3/5 runs and erase singleton runs” fits the regular generated
support.

The canonical input at `checks/audit/2fc4ca4ea6c4/input.json` includes a
singleton `7`. The Racket authority preserves it because a length-1 run is its
own midpoint; the rival erases it. `counterexample.json` records the exact
single differing cell `(2,6)`, and `racket.json` records source/rule hashes and
the supported execution.

This input passes `self_check` and belongs to the stated odd-run domain; it is
merely absent from regular sampling. Suggested future repair: draw run lengths
from `{1,3,5}` with lesson-level coverage ensuring at least one singleton and
one longer run, then declare a singleton-erasure rival. Audit target left
unchanged.

Reproduction command, from packet root:

```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 2fc4ca4ea6c4 \
  --input ../checks/audit/2fc4ca4ea6c4/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/2fc4ca4ea6c4/racket.json
```
